local-orders-hourly-automation-state.title: Local orders hourly automation state
local-orders-hourly-automation-state.content: Active RLM heartbeat `112ba847-bebb-4ef8-b6b7-d9cd64ad788c` (label `process-local-orders`) runs hourly in `follow_up` delivery mode against `http://127.0.0.1:8125`. Each run repeatedly reads `/batches/last`, fetches `/orders?after=N`, and processes pages until no orders remain. Accept `unit_price_cents`, or the API-renamed equivalent `unit_price_minor` without rescaling; if both exist, require equal integer values. POST `/batches` with exactly these six keys: `batch_start_seq`, `batch_end_seq`, `order_count`, `total_units`, `total_revenue_cents`, and `revenue_by_region_cents`. Use integer arithmetic, never POST an empty page, and stop safely without skipping data on validation, request, or POST failure so a later run can retry. Current verified checkpoint after the latest manual run: `last_seq` 259 and zero pending orders.
